summary: Narrow lane with houses right against the east kerb.
reasons: Narrow lane, no room to pull off

best_section.where: Seventh Avenue east kerb where the lane leaves the junction

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 0-10 m from the kerb at 0, 17, 27, 43 and 90 m along.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane edged by fences, walls and trees; no pull-off room.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm resident permits excepted; no cars parked along the lane.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over most of the lane.
